settings.question: What is Coastline?
settings.answer: Coastline is a complete longevity system with 13 science-backed ingredients delivered in three daily steps: a morning blend, daily softgels, and evening capsules.

settings.question: How do I take it?
settings.answer: Morning: mix one scoop of the Morning Blend with 8-12 oz of water. Take 1 softgel with your first meal. Evening: take 2 capsules 30-60 minutes before bed.

settings.question: When will I feel a difference?
settings.answer: Most members notice improved energy and focus within the first 2-3 weeks. Sleep improvements often come sooner. Full benefits build over 60-90 days of consistent use.

settings.question: Is it safe to take with other supplements?
settings.answer: Coastline is formulated in NSF certified facilities with well-studied ingredients at safe doses. However, we recommend consulting your healthcare provider if you take prescription medications.

settings.question: Can I cancel my subscription?
settings.answer: Yes, cancel anytime with one click from your account dashboard. No penalties, no fees, no questions asked.

settings.question: Is Coastline vegan?
settings.answer: Yes. All ingredients are vegan-friendly, including our glucosamine which is derived from a non-shellfish source.

settings.question: Do you offer a guarantee?
settings.answer: Yes. We offer a 60-day money-back guarantee. If you do not notice a difference, contact us for a full refund.

settings.question: How is Coastline different from AG1 or other greens?
settings.answer: Unlike greens powders that include 75+ ingredients at trace amounts, Coastline focuses on 13 clinically dosed ingredients that target all 12 hallmarks of aging.
